saw_lines: High-end audio buyers choose a system once, then keep it for years and wait for a room to sound right.
So the sale is won in the first seconds of a video, before the buyer decides whether to visit a showroom.
Your 7 Google video creatives are the only paid ads we can see, so open the next three cuts with handmade in Berlin since 1977 and close on a showroom visit.
ads_1: Berlin craftsmanship films, opening on the handmade story, tested in Google video
